app.title: MD Pencil
app.subtitle: Extract text from images & PDFs into Markdown.

upload.dragDrop: Drop a file here or click to browse
upload.invalidType: Unsupported file type. (JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF)

editor.title: Markdown Result
editor.placeholder:
OCR results will appear here.
You can also type or edit directly.
editor.aiCorrectHint: Compare the original image with the result to fix spacing, typos, and language recognition.

guide.title: Markdown Syntax Guide
guide.intro: Type like the left side to get the result on the right. The formatting buttons above the editor insert these for you.

tts.notSupported: Text-to-speech is not supported in this browser.

ocr.fail: Extraction failed — make sure the image is clear.
ocr.noText: No text found. Try a different image.
ocr.pdfFail: Could not process this PDF. Check if the file is valid.

help.title: Help
help.section1Body: A tool that extracts text from images or PDFs and organizes it into Markdown. Convert worksheets, notices, and scripts into digital documents.
help.step1: Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WEBP) or PDF, or paste with Ctrl+V.
help.step2: OCR automatically extracts and formats the text.
help.section3Body: A simple way to format text with special characters. Easy to learn!
help.section4Body: Listen to results using browser speech. Play/pause/stop and speed control available. Markdown symbols are auto-removed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aiSectionBody: When enabled, an 'AI Fix' button appears in the Markdown Result panel. It sends the current page's original image together with the result to Gemini, which compares them and fixes spacing, typos, and English/Japanese recognition errors. To use it, first deploy a proxy (Netlify/Cloudflare) with your own free API key.
settings.urlHint: Enter the proxy URL you deployed. On the same Netlify site you can just enter '/api/gemini'. Your API key is never stored in this browser — it stays only on the proxy server.
settings.passwordStatusUnset: You will be asked for a password the first time you use AI correction.
settings.needUrl: A proxy URL is required to enable AI correction.
settings.aiNotReady: Enable AI correction and set the proxy URL in Settings first.
settings.aiNotFound: Proxy URL not found (404). Check that the address is correct.
settings.aiFailed: AI correction failed — keeping the current result.

password.title: AI Correction Password
password.body: A password is required to use AI correction. It must match the AI_PASSWORD environment variable set on your proxy (Netlify). The value is stored only in this browser.
